Chapter 410 - 410 Shocking; I'Ve Invented It!

Chapter 410 - 410 Shocking; I've Invented It!

410 Shocking; I’ve Invented It!

In the chemistry laboratory of Hemp Rope Technology University in America.

The intelligent experts in chemical battery who were white-haired and wore presbyopic glasses quickly wrote the reaction equation and discussed it from time to time.

In the end, they all focused their attention on the computer screen.

One hour, two hours…

Gradually, pages of extremely complicated diagrams and calculations appeared on the screen.

Immediately, the crowd erupted in enthusiastic praises.

“Oh my god! The power can actually reach such a level!”

“I can’t believe my eyes!”

“If this battery is manufactured, according to the energy consumption calculation, the endurance of the new energy vehicle can reach… more than 2,500 kilometers!”

“Traditional cars will be completely eliminated!”

“The person who researched it is a genius, definitely a genius!”

…

The editorial department of Nature quickly received feedback from Hemp Rope Technology University.

The editors were well aware of what this research represented.

It would definitely shake the world!

Therefore, the entire editorial department seized the time and published a full-page supplement on ‘The Principle and Use of Super Batteries.’

…

Tongyong Car Group.

Accius slowly poured a cup of steaming hot coffee into his mouth.

He was extremely satisfied.

Creak!

At this moment, the door to the chairman’s office was suddenly pushed open.

A white man walked in hurriedly.

Accius frowned. “Jer, I’ve told you many times. No matter what happens, as long as the sky doesn’t fall, you must stay calm!”

Jer took a deep breath and said, “Yes.”

Accius nodded in satisfaction and said, “Tell me. What happened?”

“Professor Mary Witt, Professor Justus, Professor Brewer, and other battery experts were invited by Nature to review a paper called ‘The Principle and Use of Super Batteries.

“After their repeated verification, the data in this thesis is completely correct.

“This super battery can be used in new energy vehicles with a cruising range of more than 2,500 kilometers.”

Accius dropped the coffee cup in his hand to the ground.

“The sky has collapsed!”

…

The headquarters of Shuangtian Car in Island Country.

Chairman Taro Yamamoto stared at the report in front of him without blinking. A thin layer of sweat gradually seeped out of his forehead.

The next moment, he stood up abruptly.

“2,500 kilometers, 2500 kilometers!

“F*ck!

…

In fact, it was not just the automobile industry.

When the oil and energy industries saw this thesis, they were completely shocked!

…

As for Lin Fan, who was the one who started all this, he stayed in Yi Ke City for the weekend, living a blissful life.

Monday morning, after Lin Fan ate the breakfast Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling prepared, he drove the Cullinan to Jiangbei University.

“Lin Fan!”

Lin Fan had just gotten out of the car.

Not far away, two extremely excited voices sounded.

Lin Fan followed the voice and saw that it was Professor Li Rongfa and Professor Zhao Xueqin.

They seemed to have been waiting for Lin Fan here. The moment Lin Fan appeared, they immediately called out.

“Professor Li, Professor Zhao, good morning!” Lin Fan said.

“Morning, morning…” Li Rongfa and Zhao Xueqin hurriedly said.

Then, Li Rongfa said in a solemn yet excited tone, “Lin Fan, thank you.”

“Thank you!” Zhao Xueqin bowed slightly.

As they spoke, they took out the latest Nature journal. On the cover was the paper titled ‘The Principle and Use of Super Batteries.’

Seeing this…

Lin Fan nodded his head and said calmly, “What are you thanking me for? I watched your experiment and got to write this thesis because of it. You deserve to be the second authors.”

When Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa heard this, they became even more excited and grateful.

What did he mean when he said he only managed to write this thesis after watching their experiment?

Their experiment that day was just a very basic new energy experiment.

The Principle and Use of Super Batteries directly demonstrated the ultimate results of new energy that far surpassed the era.

The experiment had nothing to do with it!

Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa had no doubt that Lin Fan had already written the thesis.

The reason why he came to the laboratory was to find an excuse to take care of them.

It was probably the same with the previous super battery thesis!

Thinking of this, Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa looked at Lin Fan with gratitude and excitement.

They bowed in unison and said sincerely, “Lin Fan, we know the truth. Thank you!”

Lin Fan’s lips twitched.

They knew the truth?

However, from the looks of it, they did not seem to know.

Forget it, forget it. In any case, what he said was the truth. He could let them think whatever they wanted.

At this moment, another excited shout sounded from behind.

“Lin Fan!”

Lin Fan followed the voice and saw that it was the director of the Institute of Science, Feng Zhixiang.

Feng Zhixiang’s eyes were bloodshot, as if he had not slept the entire night.

In fact, Feng Zhixiang did not sleep the whole night.

Last night, he suddenly found out that Lin Fan had published a paper titled The Principle and Use of Super Batteries. He then took the earliest flight and arrived at Jiangbei overnight.

Feng Zhixiang ran toward Lin Fan and almost tripped over the door.

However, he did not care at all. He hurriedly said, “Lin Fan, how far have you gone with your research on the battery? When can it be produced?”

Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa pricked up their ears.

They were also very curious about this.

Lin Fan yawned. “When? I’ve already invented it.”

“You invented it?!” Feng Zhixiang’s eyes widened, and he quickly said, “Is what you said true?”

“Yes,” Lin Fan said.

“Good, good, good, hahaha! That’s great!” Feng Zhixiang shouted toward the sky.

It was no wonder that he would be like this.

One had to know…

Since foreign countries developed cars decades earlier than Hua Nation, all kinds of technologies and patents were in their hands.

If Hua Nation wanted to develop cars, they had to find another way!

After careful research and discussion, Hua Nation finally set its sights on electric vehicles.

The super battery that Lin Fan had developed could be used perfectly in electric vehicles, allowing Hua Nation’s cars to overtake others!

Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa, who were beside them, listened to their conversation. Their jaws dropped, and they were completely stunned.
